# Claim Veridicality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ClaimVeridicality`](gmeow-ClaimVeridicality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ClaimVeridicality>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The veridicality status of a claim — whether it is untrue, licensed-false (fiction, satire, sarcasm), or true. A closed value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses) that makes the licensed-falsehood safety property explicit, separating intentional deception from harmless fictional assertion.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ClaimVeridicality`](gmeow-ClaimVeridicality.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:claimVeridicality`](../properties/gmeow-claimVeridicality.md) — the closed set of individuals (untrue, licensed falsehood) that distinguish harmless fictional assertion from deceptive untruth as an explicit safety property.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-status subclasses (statuses are individuals) and avoid using it as a global truth flag; veridicality is a frame-relative, standpoint-indexed assessment, never an isFalse axiom ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Reference the seeded individuals ([`gmeow:veridicalityUntrue`](../individuals/gmeow-veridicalityUntrue.md), [`gmeow:veridicalityLicensedFalsehood`](../individuals/gmeow-veridicalityLicensedFalsehood.md)) from a claim via [`gmeow:claimVeridicality`](../properties/gmeow-claimVeridicality.md); extend with new individuals rather than subclasses if a finer status is needed.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:veridicalityLicensedFalsehood`](../individuals/gmeow-veridicalityLicensedFalsehood.md) a [`gmeow:ClaimVeridicality`](gmeow-ClaimVeridicality.md).
